en.bestFor: A short brand outro that closes your video on the brand logo, optionally with a call to action or sign-off.
en.structure: Always a single 3–4 second clip. The length can't be changed and there is no story.
en.hook: One single resolving move: props gather and settle into the logo, the camera zooms out to the logo card, props fade away, or the logo stamps in.
en.arc: Closing beat (props converging or a mascot finishing a gesture) → everything resolves → the logo card holds as the very last frame of your video.
en.narrator: Usually no voice; at most one very short spoken sign-off or call to action. An attached mascot can wave goodbye or move aside to make room for the logo.
en.visual: Look and palette come from the chosen visual style. A calm canvas with few elements, clean enough to hold as the last frame. An attached logo is reproduced exactly; without one, the brand name appears as title lettering, with one optional short CTA line.
en.audio: No background music — one soft resolving sound (chime, pop or stamp) synced to the logo landing.
en.rules: Exactly one 3–4 second clip. An attached logo is never redrawn, restyled or cropped. No subtitles beyond the logo or title and one optional CTA line, and it ends on the logo card without looping back.
